provenance.authoritative_connectivity: placed/routed DEF NETS connections before routing clauses
provenance.scope: local continuous refinement of all eligible combinational cells in the published GCD DEF
provenance.selection: all eligible cells sorted by DEF instance name; optional prefix for verification

verilog_crosscheck.interpretation: earlier synthesis Verilog differs from the repaired DEF; not interchangeable netlists

wire_model.model: one minimum-width straight segment per driver-receiver branch; no shared tree

provenance.fit: median per-output Liberty rise/fall load slopes and intercepts at nearest 0.04 ns slew, load indices 1:5
provenance.fixed_pin_policy: fixed input/output pins are separate timing endpoints, breaking sequential feedback
provenance.pin_positions: cell centers; no variant-dependent pin offsets
provenance.timing_weights: one per driven stage, fixed for the entire run; not worst-path timing or STA
provenance.policy_weights: declared experiment parameters, not fitted to an industrial sizer
provenance.normalizers: all-small selected variants at the published reference, fixed throughout optimization

A1.extension: smooth LSE and square-root RC lengths on all real coordinates

A2.scope: all placements, not just sampled queries

A3.multipliers: empty vectors; exact binary graph cuts replace dual iterations
